title: Jehoshaphat's Victory

questions.question: Who came against Jehoshaphat for battle?
options: The Moabites and Ammonites, and some of the Meunites
questions.correctAnswer: The Moabites and Ammonites, and some of the Meunites
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:1 (ESV): "...the Moabites and Ammonites, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat for battle."

questions.question: What did Jehoshaphat do when he was afraid?
options: Set his face to seek the LORD and proclaimed a fast
questions.correctAnswer: Set his face to seek the LORD and proclaimed a fast
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:3 (ESV): "Then Jehoshaphat was afraid and set his face to seek the LORD and proclaimed a fast..."

questions.question: What did Jehoshaphat say about their power against the great horde?
options: We are powerless... but our eyes are on You
questions.correctAnswer: We are powerless... but our eyes are on You
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:12 (ESV): "O our God... For we are powerless against this great horde... but our eyes are on you."

questions.question: Who did the Spirit of the LORD come upon in the assembly?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:14 (ESV): "And the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah..."

questions.question: What did Jahaziel say about the battle?
options: The battle is not yours but God's
questions.correctAnswer: The battle is not yours but God's
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:15 (ESV): "...Do not be afraid... for the battle is not yours but God's."

questions.question: Who did Jehoshaphat appoint to go before the army?
options: Those who were to sing to the LORD and praise him in holy attire
questions.correctAnswer: Those who were to sing to the LORD and praise him in holy attire
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:21 (ESV): "...he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and praise him in holy attire, as they went before the army..."

questions.question: What happened when they began to sing and praise?
options: The LORD set an ambush against the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD set an ambush against the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:22 (ESV): "And when they began to sing and praise, the LORD set an ambush against the men of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir..."

questions.question: How long did it take to gather the spoil?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:25 (ESV): "...It was so much that they could not carry it away. They were three days in taking the spoil..."

questions.question: What did they call the valley where they blessed the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:26 (ESV): "...Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Beracah to this day."

questions.question: Why was the fear of God on all the kingdoms?
options: They heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: They heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:29 (ESV): "And the fear of God came on all the kingdoms... when they heard that the LORD had fought..."

questions.question: With whom did Jehoshaphat join in building ships?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:35 (ESV): "After this Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined with Ahaziah king of Israel..."

questions.question: Where were the ships to go?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:36 (ESV): "He joined him in building ships to go to Tarshish..."

questions.question: What happened to the ships?
options: They were wrecked and were not able to go
questions.correctAnswer: They were wrecked and were not able to go
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:37 (ESV): "...the LORD has wrecked your works. And the ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tarshish."

questions.question: Who prophesied against Jehoshaphat regarding the alliance with Ahaziah?
options: Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah
questions.correctAnswer: Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:37 (ESV): "Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat..."

questions.question: Of what lineage was Jahaziel?
options: A Levite of the sons of Asaph
questions.correctAnswer: A Levite of the sons of Asaph
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 20:14 (ESV): "...Jahaziel the son of Zechariah... a Levite of the sons of Asaph..."

key_verse_text: And he said, “Listen, all Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem and King Jehoshaphat: Thus says the LORD to you, ‘Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed at this great horde, for the battle is not yours but God’s.
